```yaml
name: Desktop Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g., v1.0.0)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    name: Build and Release Desktop App
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            artifact_name: clawdstrike-desktop-macos
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            artifact_name: clawdstrike-desktop-linux
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            artifact_name: clawdstrike-desktop-windows

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install Rust targets
        run: rustup target add ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-modules-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TypeScript checks
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Run Vitest tests
        run: npx vitest run

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --workspace

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings

      - name: Build Desktop App
        run: |
          npm run build:desktop
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}
          path: |
            dist/*.dmg
            dist/*.AppImage
            dist/*.deb
            dist/*.exe
            dist/*.msi
          retention-days: 5

  create-release:
    name: Create GitHub Release
    needs: build-and-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            artifacts/clawdstrike-desktop-macos/*
            artifacts/clawdstrike-desktop-linux/*
            artifacts/clawdstrike-desktop-windows/*
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
